about: Every finding that rule version 4 (the code-review fixes) adds over version 3 across all 12,074 templates: 72 findings, all labelled (not sampled). Version 3 is the one measured on the held-out sample; this file covers only what the fixes newly report.

security/insecure-transport.note: Fixed public hosts over http:// whose path contains {{ }} (ip-api.com, openlibrary.org, openweathermap.org...)

security/secret-in-url.note: Mostly Alpha Vantage keys (16 upper-case letters and digits), previously mistaken for ALL_CAPS placeholders

security/webhook-no-auth.note: Third-party callbacks (Twilio, Vapi, gotoHuman) with no auth. Previously skipped because the name contained 'callback'

security/code-eval.note: eval in an AI tool-code node; child_process in Code nodes

security/hardcoded-secret.note: Same findings as before; only the masked text in the message changed

falsePositives.reason: key= is a base64 timestamp on a demo API; can't tell it is a secret. Counted as wrong to be conservative.
OAuth redirect: must be public. Fixed after labelling (pattern now covers 'auth callback').
N26-callback creates a login session: an OAuth-style redirect, public by design.
Short-link redirect service: public by design.
